room_description: A colorful classroom with a green chalkboard showing a line graph, a teacher's desk, and several student desks arranged in rows.

key_moments.description: Inspecting a cloth doll lying on the floor between the student desks.
Looking at musical notes painted on the right wall.
Zooming in on the colorful ball pit seen through the classroom door.
Examining a toy crib and shelves in the adjacent playroom.
Finding a 3x3 grid lock panel hidden behind a poster.
Entering a combination sequence of shapes on the grid panel.
Retrieving a key half from the unlocked panel.
Completing the Lights Out style puzzle game on a tablet.
Picking up the full key to escape.

solution_steps: Examine the abacus/block toy in the playroom.
Note the position of the blank spots to figure out the missing letters.
Input the letters 'G', 'I', 'R', 'L' onto the four interactive blocks on the abacus.
Look at the symbols painted on the wall.
Go to the three-panel combination lock behind the poster.
Match the symbols found on the wall on the lock.
Tap the tiles to turn them all blue. Tapping a tile changes its color and the color of adjacent tiles.

final_action: Using the acquired key to unlock the main door and escape the classroom.
